[689] Powers and abilities
[690] When angered, Sidious was a frightening sight to behold and an overpowering opponent.
[691] Trained to perfection by Darth Plagueis, Darth Sidious was considered by many, including Darth Vader[134][223] and Luke Skywalker,[134] to be the most powerful Sith Lord in the entire history of the Sith—something he himself firmly believed.[1][39] His status as such had also been documented within the the second edition of an important historical chronicle.[4] Additionally, he was the only Sith Lord in a thousand years to achieve the ultimate goal of the Sith: to eradicate the Jedi Order and bring the galaxy under the rule of the Sith.[39] Even his bodily death was not initially enough to end his reign.[19] He was also considered the one Force user to have successfully tamed the Dark Side of the Force, exceeding even that of Ulic Qel-Droma.[133] He brought about the greatest period and depth of darkness to the galaxy and the Force until the rule of Darth Krayt and the One Sith.[204]
[692] He started his rise as a Sith as a young man who had the skill to use his powers to hide his Force-sensitivity and to murder those who could not touch the Force. Learning from a Sith Lord, he swiftly gorged upon dark powers. He thought his power was swollen ten times over by the time he was ready to take out Demask. After ending his master, Sidious anointed himself as the most powerful Sith of all time. The dark side itself coronated him as the avatar of darkness in the moments after he killed his mentor, with the ghosts of long-dead Sith whispering his authority and status.[1] Sidious slew his master when he thought he knew all the secrets,[37] and would go on to leverage his powers and ruthlessness to take the galaxy as his own. In the days before he claimed his throne, he was a black hole in the Force and a void of pure darkness, a singularity of power beyond words when viewed with Force sight.[39]
[693] It seems that only Yoda had the Force abilities required to single-handedly duel Sidious to a standstill, although even that was not enough to defeat the Dark Lord, due to the Sith Lord's use of the battlefield.[13] Another single individual who was able to briefly hold Palpatine was Galen Marek, but only through the Sith Lord wanting to turn, not kill Marek. Though Palpatine ultimately managed to kill off Marek and was unharmed by the explosion of power upon the rouge Sith/Jedi's death. (Due to Marek holding off Palpatine's attempt at attacking Kota, his intended target, the Jedi general got away, with Palpatine not being happy about this afterward).[26]
[694] He continued his studies as Emperor, gathering as much learning about the Force as he could, including shamanism of Jarvashqiine and Tyia tales.[133] Moreover, he developed new powers after his death and return to life,[19] including the power to open vortexes across the galaxy.[192]
[695] Lightsaber training
[696] Darth Sidious, master of all seven forms of lightsaber combat
[697] Despite his frail appearance, Darth Sidious was immensely skilled in lightsaber combat, having mastered every conceivable form by the time of the Clone Wars.[224] He was ambidextrous and could change his fighting style at a whim—keeping his opponents unsure of what his next move would be. Having fully mastered every single form of lightsaber combat and all their techniques and stances and capable of using each form equally effectively ambidextrously, Sidious drew his opponents in, fighting less than his true capability, and then striking the fatal blow when his opponents thought they had the better of him. When fighting at full strength, the Sith Lord was a terrifying opponent.
[698] In harmony with his master, Sidious faced two hundred droids with blasters and kept themselves safe and knocked the shots back to scrap the training robots. Likewise, the pair defeated an army of Kursid using only non-fatal stunning force pikes and refraining from unleashing their lightning bolts and mentall throws. During his assassination of the Gran Protectorate, the speed and ferocity of his technique was so great that it appeared as though his victims were dispatched by a phantom. There were no survivors.[1]
[699] Similarly, he moved too fast for Maul during one of their training regimen duels[43] and traced his apprentice's body with his saber so fast that Maul could not block his display of saber mastery.[41] During his duel to test Maul and bring him up as a full Sith, he was bitten and hurt, though he won in the end; in so doing he forced Maul to embrace his hate of Sidious, then the master revealed truths and praised his student's fury which he said marked him as a worthy Sith.[43][41] He fought Maul again, against Savage as well, going to Mandalore to cast them down. In a blinding storm of blows, his twin sabers were matched against the brothers. He dominated them with his skill and power in the Force (both augmenting his body to fight on their level and with using his powers to attack), enduring kicks and blows, and though he strained to win, he was able to take Savage's life and capture Maul.[101][104] It was not hard for him to disarm Dooku's body while his minion was possessed by Talzin.[108]
[700] As a result of his tremendous skill, and use of the Force to gain an edge, he effortlessly killed Agen Kolar and Saesee Tiin—who were considered to be two of the finest lightsaber duelists of their time—each with a single blow, and while also engaged with Mace Windu, he easily slew the formidable Kit Fisto only moments later. He then went toe-to-toe with Windu, even briefly gaining the upper hand, only being disarmed by the latter when Windu drew upon Anakin Skywalker's fear and attack along Shatterpoints.[13][39] Later, Sidious, though confused by Yoda's sheer skill and power, was able to almost go toe-to-toe with Yoda himself for an extended period of time,[116] but was eventually disarmed by the Grandmaster, forcing him to rely on the Force for the rest of the confrontation. Indeed, after his saber was struck from his hand, he nearly died, only repelling Yoda by shooting electricity so that the Grandmaster had to stop his attack and defend by both blade and the Jedi arts of absorption.[114]
[701] In addition, shortly after the formation of the Galactic Empire, Sidious effortlessly killed three of the five Jedi prisoners brought before him in a single swift strike.[119] During his fight with Galen Marek, he parried a saber-stroke from the newly-minted Jedi.[211]
[702] Many years later, Palpatine, moments after coming back in one of his clone bodies, engaged and defeated Luke Skywalker in a had-fought one-on-one lightsaber duel in his clone labs on Byss (though even he got slammed by Luke),[7] and barely lost to the latter in their second encounter. It should be noted that Luke's victory was also aided by the fact that he was boosted by Leia's Force Harmony.[8]
[703] Sidious had an extremely aggressive dueling style and augmented his swordplay by using Force speed, which allowed him to defeat three experienced Jedi Masters at once with very little effort. His style was a combination of brutal aggression and lethal precision making him an almost unstoppable opponent. Palpatine's brutal fighting style allowed him to overwhelm Luke Skywalker during their first duel,[7] and Skywalker (with the aid of a princess and her unborn child's energy empowering him) only barely defeated him during their second altercation.[8] In fact, the only people known to have even disarmed him in lightsaber combat were Mace Windu,[13] Yoda,[114] and (in the literal sense) Luke Skywalker.[8]
[704] Although the full extent of Sidious's mastery of each form of lightsaber combat have not been displayed, he had enough competence with the forms of Form VII/Juyo, Form II/Makashi, Form VI/Niman, and also apparently Form V/Shien or Form III/Soresu to teach them to his apprentice Darth Maul. At times, Sidious displayed considerable proficiency in applying Force attacks into his lightsaber combat, which can be attributed to his superb skills in Niman. He also used a Form V opening stance when up against Mace Windu and at times has displayed reasonable skills in deflection, apparently due to his mastery of Shien.
[705] Although Sidious usually used only one lightsaber, he was also exceptionally accomplished in Jar'Kai, wielding both of his weapons against Darth Maul and Savage Opress with impeccable profiency. Utilizing a violently ferocious yet flawlessly fluid fighting style, his skill in dual blade combat was great enough that he was able to not only fight on par with both brothers simultaneously, but he was able to gain the upper hand, ultimately separating them from each other. He then proceeded to swiftly kill Opress, despite his immense physical strength and use of a double-bladed lightsaber, all the while simply toying with him. Once he was alone with Maul, who had added another lightsaber to his own, Sidious retained a slight advantage over his former apprentice and while he was briefly pushed back in a blade lock, he was ultimately able to best him, forcing his lightsabers down Maul's own and then ripping them away from the Zabrak's grasp. However, this was not accomplished without visible effort and struggle;[101] Sidious had nearly been bested by a seventeen-year-old Maul on Hypori, despite the Zabrak being in a weakened state.[41][43][146]
[706] While Sidious may have never wielded a saberstaff in combat, viewing them as fit only for "barbarians" within the Sith,[21] he nonetheless appeared capable with this variation. He was competent enough to teach Maul on how to use it and was dexterous enough to spin his apprentice's saberstaff with a single hand.[41]
[707] Ironically, despite Sidious' masterful dueling skills, he was fairly disdainful of lightsaber combat in general, believing the Sith to have grown beyond the need for lightsabers. They would use these weapons, he once told Darth Vader, "if only to humiliate the Jedi."[35] However, when he faced the greatest of foes he turned once more to his sword, for he fought Maul and Savage,[101] Windu, Yoda,[13] and Starkiller with Sith armament;[211] and during his fights with Luke after his second resurrection, he used a stolen Jedi lightsaber.[7][8] His saber would later become viewed as a holy relic by the One Sith.[204]
[708] Force powers
[709] Sidious demonstrates his prowess at telekinesis during his battle with Yoda.
[710] In addition to his lightsaber combat skills, Darth Sidious was one of the most powerful Force users of all time, perceived in the Force by his apprentice, Darth Tyranus, as a "black hole of the dark side."[39] Both Luke Skywalker and Darth Vader, likewise, had viewed Palpatine as having become the Dark Side's most powerful expression.[134] Sidious's relationship with the dark side was so deep to the point that he became a possession of the dark, and the dark became a possession of his. As an apprentice under Darth Plagueis' tutelage, he learned all the known dark side powers of his predecessors and quickly excelled to the point that he soon came to consider himself the Sith'ari.[21] Palpatine's mastery of the Force was so immense, having spent decades immersing himself in the many facets of the Force and researching it, which reportedly granted him full mastery over almost all known Force powers and he also managed to discover and master previously unknown techniques, allowing him to create new powers almost at whim,[133] because of this, even he at times wondered if the Force had been so strong in anyone before him, feeling a monster rising from the core of himself, impatient to unleash itself. Shortly after the death of his master, Sidious received a most powerful vision from voices that proclaimed his reign, anointing him as the master of the dark and granting him feelings of the earth quaking and stars flickering to honor his moment. He himself considered that the simple act of glancing at him was tantamount to glimpsing the dark energy that bound and drove the galaxy. Even prior to his induction into the Sith, his Force potential was powerful enough to block out Darth Plagueis' (while adopting the public identity of Hego Damask) mind reading abilities when they first met, and later able to effortlessly and telekinetically murder his parents, siblings, and their personal guards. When he slew Plagueis, the dark side of the Force itself spiritually crowned him and many Sith ghosts chanted his praise, and in his euphoria it felt like stars moved to anoint his moment.[1]
[711] As his plans played out as chancellor, he ever grew in power since he assumed leadership of the Republic and the Sith,[36] and seemed to have almost unlimited power.[190] On Mandalore, Maul saw him as a dark sun of power, awe and terror hypnotic in grandeur.[104] Dooku did not dare question his power[78] and when seeing him in the Force truly, perceived him as a black hole, a darkness beyond darkness, perfect and beyond power.[39] Yoda considered him to be the most powerful darksider the Grandmaster had ever faced.[114] In 19 BBY, Sidious was considered by Vader to be so powerful that in Vader's view at that point Sidious could only be overthrown by Vader if he had the help of Karness Muur via his talisman, Muur being a Jen'Jidai founder of the Sith who would later go on to briefly contend with Darth Krayt and who was thought to pose a threat to the entire galaxy.[123][225] Even as Palpatine continued to age, he was still extremely powerful and skilled in the usage of the Force, with his power allowing him to sustain himself beyond his natural lifespan. At full power, his Force abilities proved so great that it required a large amount of highly powerful and skilled Force adepts to defeat him, as shown by how he was captured by Zaarin's forces with the aid of Arden Lyn and her students aboard the Majestic[167] and when he was defeated over Pinnacle Base by the combined efforts of Luke Skywalker, Leia Organa Solo, and then-unborn Anakin Solo.[134] Vader himself, being greatly weakened from his injuries as he was, would not dare challenge Palpatine without aid from another powerful Force adept, resulting in him searching for a powerful apprentice.[223] By his death, Palpatine had become a nexus of the Dark Side of such power he could tear apart the fabric of space.[134] When he died, he exploded with blue fire and a horrific gale.[5] Even after his death, his power proved too great to be contained by Chaos and it required every single deceased Jedi Knight to keep Palpatine from escaping Chaos and wreaking havoc on the galaxy.[9]
[712] Sidious was a master of using Force lightning.
[713] Palpatine was incredibly skilled in Force lightning and was known to use this both as a lethal attack, and as a way of torturing his enemies.[5] He shot a bolt that grounded on his master's breaking mask, shorting out Damask's life-support.[1] If used to its full potency, the Emperor could instantly reduce one or more people into charred husks.[117] Although his Force lightning was generally blue in color,[13][5] it also emerged as purple.[26] While he was rarely at arms in the Clone Wars, he did use a few bolts to torture Maul as he captured him, having already killed Savage with his sabers.[101][104] During his battle with Talzin, he used his lightning to blast Darth Tyarnus, exorcising the witch from the Serennian, then engaged the now properly-enbodied witch mother in a contest of lightning. Both darksiders shot streams of power, Sidious gaining the edge once Dooku added his blue bolts, even though Maul poured his might into his mother. Grievous finished the witch off with a backstab, giving the Sith the field.[108] Despite his formidable skill in many other aspects of the Force, Force lightning was arguably his trademark ability and one that served him well against extremely dangerous opponents many times either resulting in their defeat or near defeat. When cornered by Mace Windu, Sidious viciously attacked him with lightning that not only nearly overwhelmed Mace Windu but also nearly caused Windu's saber to bend to Sidious's will when locked in combat with the latter's lightning. Once Anakin cut off Windu's hand, he fired the full strength of his lightning at Windu, torturing the Jedi for a few moments before using his lightning to throw Mace out of the window to his death. Sidious's potency with Force lightning was so powerful that he was even able to catch Yoda off guard with it, throwing the Jedi Master into the wall.[13] After Yoda disarmed him, he saved himself with a lightning bolt that the diminutive Jedi had to use both his saber and Force powers to block.[114] Later on in their duel was able to disarm him of his lightsaber with a powerful blast of it, despite the Grand Master's attempts to ground it, and subsequently nearly overwhelmed Yoda's efforts to absorb it. However, it should be noted that Sidious used his height to his advantage by elevating his body in order to target the lightning above Yoda's tutaminis defense and Yoda ultimately succeeded in absorbing the attack. The resulting explosion not only overwhelmed and blasted Sidious aside but also separated Yoda from Sidious, allowing the Jedi to flee.[13] During a battle against his own Stormtroopers, he killed dozens with lightning, arcing his bolts to not hurt his loyal Red Guards.[226] He slew Garrbo V'Droz with lightning.[227] He could also use this power in conjunction with telekinesis to electrify objects while levitating them before hurling them at his opponents, thus increasing the damage potency of the attack, called lightning grenade. Palpatine's mastery of Force Lightning allowed him to also generate a floating bubble shield made of lightning, which he utilized during his fight with Marek to temporarily retreat from the battle in order to have his red guards and senate guards attack Marek, which proved to be impenetrable to Marek with either the Force or his lightsaber.[26] Indeed he wrote that he fully mastered making maelstroms.[21] The Emperor burned a trio of Dark Side Prophets who had resurrected Darth Maul, though a rouge spark crackled off Vader's helmet.[228] He wiped out a whole squad of Bothans with his lightning.[151] If it hadn't been for Darth Vader's shocking intervention and his own hubris, he would have succeeded in using his lightning to torture Luke Skywalker to death, who had demonstrated that despite his natural talent in the Force at the time, even he was utterly powerless against its strength which ended up killing Vader due to the latter's repeated exposure to it.[5] Luke was left badly hurt and needed medical care to recover.[229] He knocked out Leia with lightning bolt when she used her Jedi powers to make a machine fall on him.[194] On the Eclipse he stunned Luke Skywalker with a lightning bolt, then made the fire of the dark side run down his saber, and finally made an aura of lightning to keep the Jedi away from himself once he lost a hand.[8] He also used lightning bolts to punish his soldiers, knock aside Leia as she defended her children and 3PO too, mortally wound Empatojayos Brand, and kill Rayf Ysanna.[9]
[714] Sidious was also extremely skilled with telekinesis and its sub-techniques such as Force choke and raising Force barriers; progressing from being shoved and for a lesson choked and held by his master's kine powers to mastering them for himself. Indeed, when he slew his family before becoming a Sith, he was able to throw them around until they died. On the other hand, he could do subtle things, like making two waiter-assassins' aprons move just enough to reveal a gun. When they abducted him, he mused that he could toss them around, pull their bodies apart, or even make the restaurant they were in fall down on them. When he took out Teem and his people, Sidious Force pushed a door down and floated two guards before killing them with his lightsaber and later pulled down a ceiling.[1] In his interaction with Maul in training, he somehow guided two fish to the bottom of a lake then slew the rest with his "magic", moved a tapestry with the Force; pelted Maul with little rocks, then blocked his student's storm of rocks when he did the same and then floated and smashed apart on each other two boulders from fifteen meters away. Sidious also killed a dozen Weequay guards without leaving a mark and smashed TD-D9 with a Force push,[43] and often choked Darth Maul, punishing him for interrupting[43][230] or failing. He also used his mind to throw Maul into a lake.[41] He also disarmed Maul with the Force during the latter's training.[43][41] From across the galaxy, he Force choked Maul inside Cog Hive Seven via a hologram connection.[231] He finished off his ambushed master with a Force choke.[1]
[715] He later casually levitated and choked two Mandalorians to death even before arriving in their location, then killed again with Force grips and pins. He could also easily overpower and fling both Darth Maul and Savage Opress to the window of Mandalore's Castle and keep them firmly pinned until he released them. After that he also flung them around in the battle, dragging them to fight him more as he leapt out into the night. Sidious discarded Savage's dying body with a contemptuous flick of his wrist. He also stunned Maul with a Force push and lifted him into the air before slamming him to the ground.[101] He was incredibly proficient in Force Choke to the point that he can perform it to deadly effect without needing to see the target even when in large distances away, as shown by how during a hologram call he (on Coruscant) was able to completely subdue a surprised Tyranus in his home castle on Serenno in a Force choke with a single hand gesture.[232]
[716] Before his arrest, Sidious used the Force to turn on his lightsaber (hidden in a statue so it would burn itself a hole out and after the battle he used the dark side to draw new clothes to himself.[39] He did a trick with a Force pull, summoning his blade from under his sleeve when he fought Windu and Yoda. For all his power, he failed to stop Yoda from slamming him with Force push. During his battle with Yoda, he levitated several Senate pods simultaneously, including the one he was standing on, with incredible dexterity and precision. Sidious used the pods he lifted as weapons, driving Yoda back, though the Grandmaster was able to use his powers to seize one and throw it back, nearly crushing Sidious before he jumped away.[13] In the moments after he faced Yoda, he also triggered an alarm button and floated his pod down. After Vader was reborn into his suit, the man once called Anakin lashed out with Force crushes and a scream of total horror at his ruined life and dead wife. The Chosen One was unable to touch Sidious with his assault, though he crumpled many medical droids and tools around him in blind rage.[39]
[717] The Emperor's telekinetic powers, vast indeed, allowed him to crush people and with a few moments of effort caused a building to collapse.[233] He even had the power of Force Flight, able to hover above the ground in standard gravity. as well as being capable of surrounding himself with a miniature storm of malevolent force electricity that slowed the movements of, and tortured all caught in it.[211] To get Sedriss (who murdered anyone above him in the army he considered weaker) to join him, he made a deal where they would fight and if he lost the other man would kill him, but if Palpatine won Sedriss would be his thrall. The Emperor crushed the other darksider, torturing and compressing him until Sedriss begged to serve. This done, he gained a powerful servant and Sedriss had found a true superior.[146] Palpatine mused during a foul mood that he could destroy his office with a thought and if he wanted to he could reach down and crack the foundations of the Imperial Palace, causing rubble and ruin to fall on those inside. In his office,[234] thus he would have had to use telekinesis three kilometers down.[235] He used his powers to make a cage fall on Bemel Levelisk as the architect ran away, locking him in for torture.[164] Likewise, he was skilled enough with telekinesis that he was also able to remove Luke Skywalker's restraints while barely even lifting his finger when meeting face to face on the second Death Star.[5]
[718] After his first death he demonstrated more skill with telekinesis—to the point where he could, with just few moments of effort, disintegrate a lightsaber in the hands of Leia Organa Solo without harming her, then protecting himself with a Force barrier when she went and dropped a machine chunk right on his head with her telekinesis.[194]
[719] Through the first decade of his apprenticeship under Darth Plagueis, Sidious developed powers to make his body better. Early on, he was able to make himself weightless. He possessed an exceedingly feral usage of Force rage, demonstrated when he assassinated the members of the Gran Protectorate that organized his and his Master's failed assassination attempt. Sidious was able to dim his body's senses to hear better, using this power as a senator to eavesdrop on those in the same chambers as he. He also could make his sight sharper to look at Padmé Amidala when plotting to get her elected and to examine his master's dead body.[1] He kept on using this power as Emperor.[234] He also could use the Force to leap around with great vigor and distance. During his aforementioned revenge killing of the Gran who ordered his and Demask's deaths, Palpatine used his powers to safely leap down thirteen stories, and during his assault he crashed through a door more than once.[1] Sidious employed Force leaps during his battle with Maul and Savage to move far and quickly around levels.[101] During his battle with Windu, he used the Force to literally jump the Jed and also to evade and flip around Windu. The Emperor also attempted to flee Yoda with this art then, when forced to fight, used the dark side to leap around away from attacks and to seek good angles. Likewise, he used the Force to make a time-saving leap when extracting from Mustafar a burned and dying Vader in his arms.[39] When he went to take down Darth Maul and Savage Opress, he had to use the Force to enhance his physical strength, and for all his power he strained to hold back their physical might in melee.[236] Sidious was a master of Force speed, both to compensate for his old age[39] and implementing it into his fighting style and allowing him to move so quickly that his opponents (including Maul and Jedi Masters) would often find themselves unable to react in time.[236][39] He could use the Force cloak power, for example sometimes he drew shadows around himself when appearing as Sidious in holograms, making himself look oozy and vile, showing his darkness and hiding from prying eyes.[237] The Sith could use the Force to cling to things such as not falling off a ledge when fighting Windu,[39] rooting himself in place when a vacuum pulled at him on the first Death Star during Marek's last blast in his death.[211] The Emperor was sustained by the dark side, the weight of ages light on him due to his great power in the Force,[36][238] though by the end of the Clone Wars he did often need to use the dark side to help his body take intense athletic actions.[39]
[720] One of Palpatine's Force storms decimates the New Republic Defense Fleet at the Battle of Pinnacle Base.
[721] Another very dangerous and advanced Force technique utilized by the Emperor was the ability to use the Force to transfer his essence,[133] as well as the essences of others,[164] which he used to survive death on at least three occasions.[19][7][20] He had a supply of clone bodies ready to house his spirit[19] until the last one succumbed to his own corrupting power[196] and the sabotage of his subordinates.[4] He used essence transfer not only as a pathway to immortality,[19] but also as a particularly cruel and sadistic form of torture; it is known that he killed and resurrected Imperial engineer Bevel Lemelisk seven times as punishment for the destruction of the first Death Star.[164] Palpatine was also able to transfer his spirit into the bodies of individuals who were biologically unrelated to him. After his first death, his spirit was able to transmigrate his soul across the stars to possess the body of Jeng Droga, though Palpatine's power drove Droga completely insane for a time, where he killed his crew and let the Emperor's Shadow crash into Kaal's oceans. In the end, Sate Pestage was able to find the Emperor and pull him free.[77] Keeping himself going as a spirit was an act of pure will for him.[205] He remarked that existing as a Force ghost was not great and mainly useful to enter a clone body and return to life.[23] He also intended to possess the body of Anakin Solo after the genetic material for his clone bodies was sabotaged,[4] though he never got the chance to do so, for Empatojayos Brand threw himself in the way of the transfer and along with Jedi ghosts caged the Sith, giving his life to defeat the Emperor for the final time.[9]
[722] Sidious also was proficient in pyrokinesis, as evidenced by how he was able to murder Senator Teem while the latter hid behind a curtain by easily coaxing a gentle flame from a gas-powered fireplace into a raging inferno and also dragging fire behind himself a blazing cloak. He ended the Gran by pyromancy as well, throwing a wave of that fire to drown him in flame and burning curtains.[1] He overheated a stone, making it too hot for Maul to touch to throw at him, thus training him to use the Force to throw items.[239] He thought that making things combust was child's play.[240] If he unleashed his full fury, he could throw fireballs.[234] His proficiency in pyrokinesis was also implied in what turned out to be the first dream Vader had since he became Vader, where Sidious, who was implied to have somehow survived being killed in that dream, conjured a wall of fire separating Vader from his son.[241]
[723] He made sporadic use of projecting himself, once meditating over months with his Master joining forces and sending themselves out to try to take authority over the Force,[1] and again working with Darth Tyranus to use sorcery to appear on Korriban in the image of Sifo-Dyas in a plot to turn Yoda to the dark side, before fighting him in a vision.[242] The Emperor also found the Ssi-ruuk during a mediation and appeared to them, selling them some of his subjects in a deal for their tech.[229] Sidious also could hijack a Force projection cast near him, speaking through it for a moment as he dispelled it.[193] Sidious also used Force suppression on Tyranus, making the older man's Force augmentation to keep himself immune to the ravages of age fade when Sidious appeared before him in a hologram.[237] He used his dark version of this power after he became Emperor as well.[243]
[724] Sidious also possessed some knowledge on the manipulation of midi-chlorians, having done so with Darth Plagueis in a Grand Experiment (when he and his master astral projected themselves into the Force as a single will, trying to claim lordship over the Force) taking place in 42 BBY that indirectly and unwittingly resulted in the birth of the Chosen One, Anakin Skywalker. He achieved a "galactonic" breakthrough on controlling the midis when working under his mentor who did most of the work. He was unable to fully master the technique prior to murdering Plagueis, leaving some secrets on the table, though he claimed to have a level of competence with the technique that would have enabled him to save Plagueis while he was suffocating, the glowing-eyed apprentice boasting as much to the Muun.[1] When Vader fell on Mustafar, Sidious rushed to his aid. The master found his burnt apprentice and placed a hand on his brow, willing him to live and giving him healing from the dark,[39][244] putting forth all his power to keep Vader alive. He once thought of trying to make another life form like Anakin by controlling the organelles of the Force. It was assumed that given a bit of time, he could learn how to live alongside Vader for one hundred centuries, as long as the Sith used their arts to keep their lives and did not kill each other before the ten thousand years passed.[241] He told Ferus Olin that he could teach the young man how to use the same power over death and life themselves and make himself stronger than Darth Vader.[27] Additionally, Palpatine was able heal others through the light side of the Force.[245] He could sense and remove from himself poison, often using this cantrip when he ate and so that he did not get drunk.[1]
[725] Palpatine could command others not just by his charm and the authority he held as emperor or his previous roles, but also by using the Force to bend others to his will. In his time as a senator, he mind-tricked a Sullustan into letting him know what he was up to, before taking the other man's memory of the last few moments away.[1] Darth Tyranus claimed that his powers of mental influence confounded many of his co-workers in the Senate.[17] He also mind-tricked Grievous into displaying him to the Republic via hologram after the general kidnapped him.[246] He used his arts to guide and control the people in his government.[133] At some point he used his powers to make thousands or millions[247] of people forget seeing the Lusankya being buried in Imperial Center's soil,[40] and used memory rub on Azrakel, making the man forget everything.[146] He almost was able to mind-control Galen Marek into killing Vader and joining him, only failing when Kota Force pulled his saber out of his robe and used it to kill some guards, forcing the Emperor to defend himself with lightning.[143] It was mentioned by Luke Skywalker that the Emperor's very voice had a hypnotic lull to it whenever he was outwardly projecting his dark side Force powers.[179] He almost mind-controlled Luke Skywalker into joining him, only failing when Leia helped her brother.[195] The Dark Lord also could make an aura of dominion, crushing the resolve of others.[8] He could also thrust terror into others' minds.[248] He also could use the Force to compel beasts to his wishes, makes fish swim where he wanted.[239] Overall, his powers of control and persuasion had been drawn from the very blackest depths of the dark side of the Force.[207]
[726] Darth Sidious was highly adept at foreseeing the future, often utilizing the power to see his plots to fruition, ensuring that all would proceed as he had envisioned. He also got a vision of Aborah as a metaphorical tornado of dark side power when he nestled into the Force en route to the island. When he slew his master, he raised his blazing yellow eyes and saw through the ceiling and untold trillions of miles stars seeming to glow differently for a moment to mark his moment. Then, his body feeling like it was on fire, he tried to see visions of his Sith "ancestors" and peer at what they had done encoded in the light-waves of cosmic distance.[1] While he did foresee that Maul probably would die on Naboo and did not bother to tell him,[23] he did not understand a sense he got when Maul fell, and did not realize his vision came true until he came to Theed and was told the normal way.[1] He knew Luke would not turn on Bespin, and that the boy would try to redeem Vader.[163] He foresaw much of what was going to happen around the time the DS2 was coming online, such that he felt secure. Added to this, he had visions of how powerful Luke could become, stronger than Vader even, if Luke fell to the dark side.[133] He also invoked knowledge that the Millennium Falcon was going to Onderon.[249] He also set farsight on baby Anakin Solo, but Leia sensed and broke his farsight, causing him to lose control and lightning to flare out of his body.[9] The Force often revealed things to him before they happened, giving him strong precongative powers. As an untrained young man, he had premonitions that almost always came true, such as when he just knew that Hego Damask would visit him at Chandrila’s Gladean Park, a hunting preserve outside of Hanna City.[1] He also was aware Maul was about to give him a call just before the transmission came due to the ripples in the Force its sending thrust before it.[250] Sidious was a better diviner than Yoda, though he still could be surprised and got taken off guard with the events on Geonosis and the loss of Gunray's chair, though he quickly made plans to deal with such problems.[64] He felt when Vader was in danger at Obi-Wan's hands.[13] Likewise, after becoming a monarch, he felt the ripple of to be just before Mas Amedda contacted him over hologram.[241] He tended to know ahead of time what plans crime lords and Moffs had,[251] and knew of Xizor's attack.[252] His divination was never perfect, but he knew much of how Luke could fall to the dark side.[179]
[727] He also had a strong Force sense, knowing when Pax Teem was gawking at him before he saw the Gran and the dark side cooled his wild rage and made him look at the best place to attack Teem's compound during the retribution strike after the senator had tried to kill the Sith order. He also seemed to just know when Maul was unhappy about being bitten by a snake, the drawing his minion had made, and everything else about the young Sith; and could sense Maul's ship, the Scimatar, even when the vessel was cloaked. He also felt Maul's "death" on Naboo, though he did not understand what he sensed and brushed it off. The Force also spoke to him, telling him moments before he felt Maul's fall when to strike and murder his master, usurping the rule of the Sith.[1] Like with Maul he understood Dooku.[253][78] He sensed when Yoda went to Korriban and that this was a great chance to hurt the Jedi.[199] To learn what Anakin's Sith name should be, Palpatine queried the Force and the dark side answered, "Vader."[39] He felt the death of every Jedi during Order 66, though he could not glean detail beyond that the dark side was stronger with every death and that if Anakin killed Jedi he would become more Sith-like.[114] He was aware of Vader's issues in burying Anakin and sometimes sensed the other Sith's general plots and battles,[254] and sensed conspiracies against his Imperial rule.[133] He learned of The Emperor felt when the first Death Star was blown up and both that the dark side would guide him to greater heights and that whoever the pilot who blew it up might be, that man was a figure of great import.[234] Likewise, he sometimes could detect people strong in the Force or massive uses of power, such as when he was awed by Demask's power when the Muun let him sense some of his ability; and he was positively staggered when at Sate's warning he opened himself to the Force and felt his master over at the Lodge of the Canted Circle unleashing every iota of power he could dredge up against the Maladian assassins. He also felt when Kycina was about and that she could use the dark side and when he let the Force guide him from this, he got ahold of Maul.[1] He also sensed when Yoda was taxed to his limit blocking his lightning.[39] After Vader conquered Kashyyyk, Sidious sensed how Vader was becoming more molded to the dark side and drinking deeper of the dark.[241] He also learned of Gethzerion by his powers, and knew she could be a danger to him if she got loose from her planet.[146] Palpatine also was fond of dropping into the Force and seeing through it more than his living eyes, his hearing sometimes dimming as he saw others as bundles of energy more than matter. Indeed, as his study under Damask continued apace, he became ever more able to see the universe as currents of imateria and others ever more as life energy rather than mere flesh, blood, and bone. When he looked at his master after the failed Maladian hit against the Muun, Palpatine saw his mentor as a nuclear inferno of the dark side's power, shaped into worthiness and might by his trials and battles. Plapatine also could see his master commanding the midis in his own body, trying to out-heal Sidious's assault. The Sith was able to detect life near him, as when he felt the life-forms in his master's laboratories. His prima vitae meant he also knew when the Rebels landed on Endor.[179] His powers sometimes revealed to him who exactly was near him, as when he sensed that Sate Pestage was outside his door moments before the other man told him about the attack against Plagueis[1] or when he knew Maul came to his room by the sheer malevolence of the entering aura.[255] He also knew when the Rebels landed on Endor.[179] After coming back to life, he could not find Jacen and Jaina, but did feel that Leia was pregnant.[195]
[728] Palpatine also could sometimes detect lies, such as when he knew Gunray was not being honest and also knew that Maul was not lying.[250]
[729] Furthermore, Sidious was extremely proficient in Force stealth, keeping almost all his Force-sensitivity hidden from Lord Plagueis when they were first becoming friends. He also cloaked himself countless times from the Jedi as he rose towards becoming leader of the Republic. Ronhar Kim, Dooku, and Sifo-Dyas all failed to sense he was a Sith, though Dooku noticed something was a bit off about him and Damask. Likewise, he could let people feel his power, as when he lowered his hiding power, letting Kycina then sense him as a powerful dark side user.[1] In the same vein, he also could mask himself alongside Maul so they could watch the Jedi Temple, though if they had entered it together, even Sidious's powers would be an inefficiency and the Jedi would know the truth.[250] Dooku stated that the Dark Lord was using the Force to hide his dark side influence over the Senate. Palpatine was able to hide his dark nature from the Jedi Order for many years before allowing himself to be discovered. Sidious was so powerful in the dark side that he was able to cloud the Jedi's vision and foresight, making it exceedingly difficult to predict future events and keeping his true goals hidden.[39] This allowed him to bide his time and plot his rise to power while the Jedi were unable to sense him,[36] a fact and feat he was proud of.[256] In addition, he could also obscure his presence and ties to his public persona and vice versa, as especially evident by how he managed to elude even well-trained Jedi Masters from realizing that Palpatine and Sidious were one and the same.[1] Even Yoda found trying to clairvoyantly seek his true identity was like looking into an agonizing filthy red ocean. Still, during the Battle of Coruscant, Yoda staggered as he was able to finally sense that Sidious was on or about the planet,[246] and Mace Windu was able to sense that the dark side gathered around him in some way, and when they fought Windu was able to see his shatterpoints without issue.[39]
[730] Despite his ability to conceal his own presence with the Force and his ability to sense others with the Force, there are two notable examples of his Force sense capabilities failing him. The first time was when encountering Anakin Skywalker, where he provided him with a room and didn't even sense Anakin's Force potential, let alone realize he had a very high midi-chlorian count until then-Jedi Master Dooku informed him of such when meeting with him at a diner.[1] The second time was regarding Anakin Skywalker's son, Luke, just before the Battle of Endor, where he was unable to sense Luke's presence on the Tydirium until Vader, breaking protocol, went over to his throne room to notify him of this development personally.[179]
[731] During a hunt alongside Damask for some long-necked quadrupeds, Palpatine reached out and merged his mind into one of the creatures, then as he viewed the world out of it, he figured out how to come at it and cut it down. Though perhaps empathic was not a term easy to apply to Palpatine, he was still able to use Force empathy, feeling swells of pride from groups of Jedi and felt Gunray's had doubts from a hologram call across the galaxy.[1] Maul admitted that he could hide nothing from him after Palpatine gleaned his student's interest in his plans.[257] He also could feel Yoda's emotions in the same room.[258] When Windu and three other Jedi came to arrest him, the Sith's empathy revealed to him their grim determination as well as Anakin's distress over at the Jedi Temple. At least to Anakin, he seemed to puck a thought from the Jedi and comment on it during the Chosen One's temptations into joining the Sith.[39] He felt Vader's rage when the DS1 died from across the galactic scope and drank the fear of a group of men and women, the main leaders of his forces. Even Thrawn was scared of him when he gave them a talking to about the loss of the Death Star and what to do because of it.[234] His Force empathy let him feel Luke's rage towards him and how close he was to falling. He said as much to goad Luke into attacking him.[5] Palpatine had some skill in telepathy, using it to communicate with Mara Jade and make her hear his voice from anywhere,[28] such that they could have chats as if they were in the same room.[259] She could even draw power from him with this connection.[146] When he died, he used his connection with Mara Jade to show her a fake vision, cursing her with an urge to kill Luke Skywalker.[260] After he came back to life, he sent some mocking laughter to bother Luke.[195] He also rammed a spear of mental force and spoke in Vader's mind shortly after Luke lost his hand, dropping Vader to his knees in pain as he told Vader he had just sensed the lesser Sith's idea to clone Luke and use the clone to revolt and ordering that Luke's hand be put into storage.[227] The Emperor was able to read Vader's doubts in his plans and the armored Sith's internal fears.[241][140][179] The Emperor read Moff Jerjerrod's mind and seemed to know whatever Vader thought.[251] He stole knowledge from the minds of Jedi he captured.[146] When he met Luke, he was able to break though Luke's thought wall formed by focusing on the void of space, and the Sith that Yoda was dead.[179] He also on the second Death Star, was able to steal from Luke's mind that Leia was his sibling.[261] The Sith Master also prevented Maul from seeing him enter when the younger man was training, unless Sidious wanted to be seen. On the other side of such intrusions, Palpatine was skilled in keeping his thoughts his own, blocking out Damask's efforts to know his mind before the nobleman had had even a day of Sith training.[1] He also used a thought shield powerful and subtle enough that Shaak Ti could not get a read on his feelings when she used her Force empathy on him.[246] He also showed Mara Jade how to use this power.[262]
[732] Palpatine had a very wide-ranging Battle meditation, keeping his empire's military going with his powers, sometimes guiding a fleet or army.[133] He kept his sentinels under his total mental hold with this skill, these clones' minds erased for and by his power.[21] He used this rare talent of Sith Battle meditation[263] at Endor, so when he died, the diffused and now undirected dark side energy lain upon his fleet left them both confused with the emptiness[179] and void of the power that had given them the will to fight, their determination supplanted by Palpatine's power.[28]
[733] Palpatine could control nature and the skies and winds, from causing winds around himself when he lacked training,[1] to making winds grow intensely harsh on Vjun when he appeared via hologram there.[237] His presence also controlled a storm when he met Ferus.[139]
[734] Palpatine was also the only known being capable of producing a Force storm of his own power, a dark side technique which he himself discovered, and that had enough power to kill an entire world.[240] He used this power to kidnap Luke Skywalker off the capital planet,[192] leaving such damage that even years later the scars of his power remained.[264] Using his anger and his will, he was able to rip the space-time continuum and create a hyperspace wormhole. However, even though he claimed to have quickly achieved the mastery needed to conjure a storm simply by willing it, he openly admitted that at the early stages of his discovery and subsequent learning of the power, even he was not able to fully control it but had full confidence he would ultimately acquire the ability to achieve complete control over the storms he created with more practice.[134] By 10 ABY, indeed, the Emperor appeared to have mastered the technique to the level needed to be fully capable of controlling a Force storm, to the point that he was able to send out several storms at whim and a singularly fully powered storm required the combined efforts of Luke, Leia, and the unborn Anakin Solo through the light side to turn his dark side creation against him.[8] He wiped out the Da Soocha moon base and the entire fleet of ships above it with this power.[21]
[735] Before becoming a Sith, his anger let slip and he emanated a buffet of rage, killing flowers and battering FourDee and Plagueis alike.[1] Ferus was battered in the same way when he met Palpatine.[139] By the time of the Battle of Coruscant, he had made the LiMerge Building strong in the dark side, a site where Dooku and Maul were trained.[246] When he fought Windu and the other Jedi Masters, he stunned them with a Force scream, allowing him the time to slay three in moments.[13] The Sith learned how to feed on suffering and steal vital energy. An early experience he had in this was a minor act of drawing on the death of an animal whose senses he had invaded.[1] Among the Emperor's powers was the ability to channel the collective life essences of billions to sustain himself and his Dark Side Adepts; his victims would live in a dream-like state while his own power grew. The entire population of Byss lived under this spell until the planet's destruction by the Galaxy Gun.[265] These rites kept the people nearly mindless as their bleed-off life energy was funneled to the Emperor,[266] that formed a pool for him to use in dark side experiments.[21] He was able to blind the Falcon's sensors.[249]
[736] Sidious grew to became a highly accomplished and knowledgeable master of Sith alchemy, an ancient art that he did extensive research on. He wrote about alchemy in The Creation of Monsters, the unfinished last part of his Dark Side Compendium.[146] He rediscovered the long-forgotten art of creating chrysalides, and used it to alchemically alter rancors into fearsome chrysalis beasts used as pets at his Citadel on Byss.[267] He could make perfect alchemical-forged monsters, like ideal chrysalides, but refused to lest any betray him.[21] He also created Shadow Droids, hybrid mechanic/organic starfighters controlled by his own will, used against the Republic after his return in a clone body.[20] He may have also used alchemy to hide his true face from the Jedi and the rest of the galaxy as a senator and Chancellor of the Republic.[268]
[737] The Dark Lord also was knowledgeable and proficient in Sith sorcery, as he was aware of and able to perform an ancient ritual that casted a powerful and convincing dark illusion capable of fooling even Yoda,[242] and he is also able to use arcane rituals to detect poisons and drugs in food and drink.[1] Palpatine discovered how to call up the spirits of dead Sith and learned how to enhance his gathering of energy and unleashing electricity. He used magical rituals that disturbed the Jedi and made Anakin crave more power and to help Anakin live long enough to be put into his Vader suit.[269] He also could utter incantations in the Balc language, such as when he and Count Dooku cast a spell to try to confuse and tempt Yoda to the dark side via visions sent to Moraband, offering Yoda secrets if he turned from the light.[242] Another power he had was enchanting a hologram to stun anyone who heard the recording's sermon about the power of darkness.[195] Palpatine was also capable of performing a sith sorcery ritual to enhance the Force sensitivity of other people, which he used to enhance his Dark Side Elite's force powers.[31] During his training of Maul, he made Maul have dreams of burning the Jedi Temple, stoking the Zabrak's hate of the knights of light.[23] The Reborn Emperor also could appear in and shape Luke's dreams across the galaxy via his Sith sorcery, using this to keep him asleep when Scarab Mark VI assassin droids attacked him.[214] His magic could be used to subtly persuade others.[9]
